patronOf.en-US: Bishop and friend of the poor

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Whatever you did for one of the least of my brethren, you did it for me.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Tudo o que fizestes a um destes meus irmãos mais pequeninos, foi a mim que o fizestes.

meta.face: A young man of about twenty, clean-shaven, with fair blond straight-to-wavy hair cut to the jaw, a kind face, his gaze lowered to the beggar.
meta.basis: Sulpicius Severus's account of the cloak at Amiens, when Martin was about eighteen to twenty, with the face type of Simone Martini's Assisi fresco; fair hair keeps him apart from George. The excerpt is his memorial's communion antiphon.

sources.title: Sulpicius Severus, Life of St Martin (New Advent)
Wikimedia Commons, Simone Martini, Division of the Cloak

history.note: New card; the first draft broke the bottom frame and gave him brown curls, so it was regenerated.
